name: set_script_object_state_id

stack.evidence: func_001DC1F0 consumes one state ID, packs it into the low 24-bit payload of object operation 0x29, targets the object ID stored at Script offset 0, and queues the operation through func_001C5DE0

notes: Operation 0x29 maps to the embedded ACTION name, but its dispatcher passes state_id to func_0014F8B0, which changes the object's state field, runs the previous state's exit callback, and runs the new state's entry callback. All four JP calls pass state ID 8 in pp10.ard.
